thread_text:
Anna Park: Quick sync — I put a rough SI Accelerator curriculum doc up in the drive (link below). Goal: get a light-weight path for systems integrators to go from evaluation -> marketplace listing -> HW cert. Need input on required artifacts for each certification tier. https://drive.internal/redwood/si-accelerator :mag_right:

Miguel Torres: Linking it now. First read: do we require partner lab / on-prem access for Level 2? Seems like a blocker for smaller SIs.

Priya Shah: Short answer: Level 1 = self-study + quiz + sample solution. Level 2 = hands-on lab or remote guided lab + submission of a reference integration. Level 3 = joint customer pilot + performance report. We can add a "remote lab" option for SIs without infra.

Tom Nguyen: Nice. Can we add acceptance criteria for marketplace listing? e.g. docs, sample app, terraform module or cloud formation, and security checklist. That will speed marketplace approvals.

Anna Park: Agreed. Proposed minimum checklist (WIP):
```
- docs: quickstart + integration guide
- sample app: runnable demo (docker or cloud template)
- infra as code: terraform module or cloudformation
- test suite: smoke tests + perf snapshot
- security: threat model + data flow diagram
```

Lauren Beckett: Also recommend a one-pager marketing asset for joint announcement. One line: what the SI enables with Redwood in 2-3 bullets. We can co-brand and push to the marketplace listing page. :sparkles:

Miguel Torres: For HW partners: should we require quantization or specific perf targets before cert? eg: 2x latency improvement vs CPU baseline? That might be too prescriptive.

Priya Shah: Don't hard-require quantization. Instead document recommended profiles per accelerator and add perf bands (SLA targets) for each cert level. That way partners can opt in to optimization guidance without failing certs.

Tom Nguyen: Ops ask: include a canonical test harness we run in our Dedicated environment so results are reproducible. I can drop a small harness repo by EOD.

Anna Park: Perfect. Action items:
- Tom: test harness repo (ops)
- Priya: draft cert criteria doc (levels 1-3) + remote lab option
- Miguel: map HW partner expectations into perf bands
- Lauren: marketing one-pager template + announcement checklist
I’ll collate and move to the partner portal next week. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: docs-deploy scheduled: /deploy docs/si-accelerator -> staging at 1994567925

Miguel Torres: One small ask — can we add a "fast-track" badge for SIs who already have marketplace integrations with public cloud? Might help reduce churn.

Anna Park: Good idea. Priya, can you add a fast-track pathway (reduced lab reqs + faster review) to the draft?

Priya Shah: Yep — will add fast-track criteria and a checklist for "already market-listed" partners.

Lauren Beckett: I'll start a simple co-brand kit and a fillable marketing one-pager template (Figma link coming).

Tom Nguyen: Repo created: github.com/redwood/si-test-harness — I'll post the smoke test commands in the doc.

Anna Park: Thanks folks — if nobody objects I’ll schedule a 30m review on Wed to finalize cert tiers and publish the playbook. :calendar:

Miguel Torres: +1

Lauren Beckett: +1

Priya Shah: +1

Anna Park: Great — closing the loop here.
